content.title: DeepV2D: Video to Depth with Differentiable Structure from Motion
content.TL;DR: DeepV2D predicts depth from a video clip by composing elements of classical SfM into a fully differentiable network.
content.abstract: We propose DeepV2D, an end-to-end deep learning architecture for predicting depth from video.  DeepV2D combines the representation ability of neural networks with the geometric principles governing image formation. We compose a collection of classical geometric algorithms, which are converted into trainable modules and combined into an end-to-end differentiable architecture. DeepV2D interleaves two stages: motion estimation and depth estimation. During inference, motion and depth estimation are alternated and converge to accurate depth.
